soul_corrections.current_text: The Bearzooka is drawn as a green, hazard-striped tube [Observed; Inference].
soul_corrections.correction: The BBG Bearzooka is a coral-red hexagonal tube with glowing orange panels and grey hex collars, firing from its wide flared end [Observed]. That matches the wiki's 'red and orange lines' [Fan-wiki]. The green, hazard-striped 'BEARZOOKA' tube is the BB Zombies (2009) design.
soul_corrections.evidence: File:Photo_19-04-13_12_02_26_PM.png; BBR store File:BBR_Bearzooka.png (Mar 2012); wiki sprite tile 'bzk'; File:Bear.jpg (BBZ, green with hazard stripes); Bearzooka page: 'In BBG and BB0, it is a rocket launcher with red and orange lines. In BBZ and BB-1 it is just a dark green rocket launcher.'

soul_corrections.current_text: He holds a chunky assault rifle and carries a green hazard-striped launcher tube on his back.
soul_corrections.correction: He holds the A Salt Rifle, a sage-green rifle with salmon-pink panels and a white salt shaker mounted on top. He shoulders the Bearzooka, a coral-red hexagonal launcher tube with glowing orange panels.
soul_corrections.evidence: File:Oliver3d.png; BBR store File:A_salt_rifle.png; File:ASRconcept.png (AR3); in-game Bearzooka photos as above

soul_corrections.current_text: Green-and-dark-grey shoulder harness, small green backpack, no clothing.
soul_corrections.correction: For the BBG 2013 model: red headband, crossed bandolier of brass cartridges on dark-red straps, red wristbands, red knee bands with silver-ringed red buttons, pale grey-lavender backpack, no clothing.
soul_corrections.evidence: All 2013 'Photo 19-04-13' in-game item photos and the BBR store screenshots (2012) show this gear [Observed]. The green harness appears only in older 2D art (File:Sw_boots.png, File:Oliver-steamshot.png).

soul_corrections.current_text: A green-and-dark-grey harness with grey clips [Observed] and a small green backpack [Inference].
soul_corrections.correction: BBG 2013 in-game: brass-cartridge bandolier on dark-red straps and a pale grey-lavender backpack [Observed]. The green harness is pre-3D 2D art only.
soul_corrections.evidence: Sampled from File:Photo_19-04-13_12_02_36_PM.png: cartridges about #E9D85A, straps about #7F000A, pack about #745F7E
